title: 第15章 影噬魂狩血擂点烽烟第16章 影噬魂狩血擂点烽烟下
slug: 噬主成魔万魂幡饮血开锋
content_zh:
那团扭曲变幻的暗影，如同活化的深渊，悬浮在禁锢阴九幽的岩壁之前。
两点幽蓝魂火死死锁定着他，冰冷纯粹的吞噬欲望如同实质的潮汐，冲刷着他重创的神魂。
灰斗篷金丹老魔的搜魂之力被影魔的突然现身和恐怖咆哮强行打断，幽绿的鬼火剧烈跳动，惊怒交加！
“影魔！
滚回你的死狱深处！
这猎物是老祖的！”
灰斗篷老魔厉声呵斥，金丹威压轰然爆发，试图震慑这头凶名赫赫、连他都有些忌惮的怪物。
无形的压力如同山岳，狠狠压向那团扭曲暗影。
然而，影魔似乎对金丹威压有着极强的抗性！
它那幽蓝的魂火只是微微摇曳，扭曲的暗影反而更加剧烈地翻滚起来，发出一种如同无数砂砾摩擦的、令人牙酸的嘶嘶声！
这嘶嘶声并非攻击，却带着强烈的挑衅和…贪婪！
它显然也感应到了灰斗篷老魔神魂的强大与“美味”
但那杆散发着特殊魂力波动的破幡，对它有着更致命的吸引力！
阴九幽残破骨架内，神魂如同被两股无形的巨力撕扯！
一边是影魔冰冷纯粹的吞噬锁定，一边是灰斗篷老魔重新凝聚、更加阴狠的搜魂之力！
剧痛撕心裂肺，意识在崩溃边缘沉浮！
但就在这极致的压力下，他释放出的那丝微弱神魂气息，如同滴入滚油的水珠，瞬间点燃了导火索！
影魔那幽蓝的魂火猛地一盛！
它似乎被阴九幽主动释放的、混合着万魂幡气息的“诱饵”
彻底激怒了！

在它简单的思维里，这弱小的骨头架子竟敢挑衅！
它放弃了直接吞噬，而是猛地将扭曲的暗影膨胀开来！
“嘶——吼！”
一声更加尖锐、充满精神污染的咆哮炸响！
无数道细密的、由纯粹阴影和精神冲击构成的“影噬针”
，如同暴雨般从膨胀的暗影中激射而出！
目标，并非阴九幽，而是…
看台上，那些气息相对较弱、神魂防御不足的筑基期“观众”
噗！
噗！
噗！
无声的穿刺在灵魂层面响起！
“啊——！”
“我的头！”
“影魔！
content_en:
The twisted and changing shadow was like an activated abyss, suspended in front of the rock wall that imprisoned Yin Jiuyou.
Two points of blue soul fire locked tightly on him, and the cold and pure devouring desire was like a real tide, washing away his severely injured soul.
The soul-searching power of the gray-cloaked golden elixir old demon was forcibly interrupted by the sudden appearance and terrifying roar of the shadow demon. The green will-o'-the-wisp jumped violently, and he was filled with shock and anger!
"Shadow Demon!
Go back to the depths of your hell!
This prey belongs to the ancestor! "
The old demon in gray cloak yelled harshly, and the golden elixir's pressure exploded, trying to scare this monster with such a vicious reputation that even he was a little afraid of.
The invisible pressure was like a mountain, pressing hard against the twisted shadow.
However, Shadow Demon seems to be extremely resistant to the pressure of the golden elixir!
Its blue soul fire only swayed slightly, but the twisted shadow rolled more violently, making a tooth-breaking hissing sound like the friction of countless gravels!
This hiss is not an attack, but it is full of provocation and... greed!
It obviously also sensed the power and "deliciousness" of the gray cloaked old devil's soul.
But that broken flag exuding special soul power fluctuations has a more fatal attraction to it!
Within the broken skeleton of Yin Jiuyou, the soul seemed to be torn apart by two invisible giant forces!
On one side is the cold and pure devouring lock of the Shadow Demon, and on the other is the re-concentrated and more sinister soul-searching power of the old demon in gray cloak!
The pain is heartbreaking, and the consciousness is on the verge of collapse!
But under this extreme pressure, the faint spiritual aura he released was like water droplets dripping into boiling oil, instantly lighting the fuse!
Shadow Demon's blue soul fire suddenly surged!
It seems to be a "bait" mixed with the breath of the Ten Thousand Soul Flags that was actively released by Yin Jiuyou.
Totally outraged!
In its simple thinking, this weak frame dares to provoke!
It gave up swallowing it directly, and instead suddenly expanded the twisted shadow!
"H-ho!"
A sharper roar filled with spiritual pollution exploded!
Countless fine "shadow bite needles" composed of pure shadow and spiritual impact
, shooting out from the swelling shadow like a torrential rain!
The target is not Yin Jiuyou, but...
In the stands, those "audiences" in the foundation-building period with relatively weak auras and insufficient soul defenses
Poof!
puff!
puff!
The silent piercing sounded at the soul level!
"Ah——!"
"My head!"
"Shadow Demon!
